name: optfall-legality
description: Flesh and Blood deck legality, as of any date — per-card verdicts that each cite the rule that produced them. Zero runtime dependencies.
author: alxjrvs

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --target browser --format esm --sourcemap=linked && bun build ./src/sources/wayback.ts --outdir ./dist/sources --target node --format esm --sourcemap=linked && tsc --noEmit false --emitDeclarationOnly --declaration --declarationMap --outDir ./dist
